# Two wide frame inputs

Original private static generic signatures relate three carriers and a callback
to the same Object/nominal-bound formal pair. Both primitive inputs are long
values with independent extrema and distinct high/low words. Frozen direct,
precompiled, reflection and method-handle observers compare ordered reads,
frame writes, callback casts, identity, nulls and partial failure state. Four
wrong programs must be detected; no original bytecode or metadata is edited.
